So legal, moral, and ethical factors contributed. So C could be correct.

D. "Ginsburg does not support providing maternity leave to women alone." In the second document, Ginsburg argued for universal leave, not just maternity leave. She argued about FMLA and self-care leave. So D is basically true: Ginsburg did not support providing maternity leave to women alone. So D is correct.
